source_issues_and_limits.finding: Published Table 1: Eagle 47/Kaggle6, Peacock106/Kaggle14; local metadata/wiki: Eagle106/Kaggle14, Peacock47/Kaggle6. Preserve metadata IDs; do not silently remap the paper table.
Official metadata stores Wolf longitude +6.2603 with Europe/Dublin; published named location Dublin is inconsistent with this longitude. No source edit or correction performed.

Published Table 5 writes MJ times3.6 to kWh and gallons times0.264172 to litres; the conversion directions are inconsistent with standard MJ/kWh and customary US-gallon/litre relations. The author preprint uses MJ times0.277778. Do not apply this table again to already normalized CSV, and do not claim independent metrological calibration.

Notebook10 uses files[0:1] for non-electricity zero-gap processing, removeAnoms rereads raw CSV rather than using the already-cleaned argument, and exports _cleaned1.csv. find_zero_gaps starts count at0, while removal requires cnt>24, and trailing gap removal excludes the final timestamp. Thus the current illustrative notebook is not certified as an end-to-end reproduction of all8 published cleaned CSV. No cleaning rerun was performed.

NaN can mean original absence or cleaning removal, including seasonal long zero runs; cleaned does not mean complete, unbiased or individually calibrated. Valid non-electricity zero readings can denote off-season/off-operation.

331166 weather rows versus19*17544=333336 expected site-hours:2170 missing hour keys plus128 blank temperatures. Crow/Moose2017 valid8246/8760=94.1324%; valid/included-row coverage100% for these sites is not calendar completeness.

suitable_independent_validation: held-out2016/2017 hourly meter forecasting and weather-response benchmarking with explicit unit/mask and building/site split
external heating/cooling energy-channel pattern checks after meter-boundary qualification
not_supported: foreign meter series as observed loads of Guyuan/Urumqi/Tongliao
whole-building electrical use as heat load
gas energy as delivered heat without measured efficiency/end-use split
all same-building heat meters summed without connection boundaries
H/C or2R2C validation without indoor temperature, actual heat inputs and building envelope/ventilation/gain evidence
